pr_body:
This PR introduces a new query that displays redacted URIs of external connections along with other valuable information.

Epic: CRDB-15001
Fixes: #85905
Release note: New queries `SHOW EXTERNAL CONNECTIONS` and `SHOW EXTERNAL CONNECTION <connection name>` have been added. These queries display redacted connection URIs and other useful information such as the connection type. Access to these queries is restricted to the owner of the connection or users with `USAGE` privilege. Admin or root users will have unrestricted access to all connections.

issue_context.title: externalconn: implement `SHOW EXTERNAL CONNECTIONS`
issue_context.body:
`SHOW EXTERNAL CONNECTIONS` will display information about the external connections that a user has the `USAGE` privilege on. The connection details for each external connection provider must be redacted and so every provider will be responsible for registeringa redaction method that will be invoked before rendering the output for `SHOW EXTERNAL CONNECTIONS`.

Epic [CRDB-15001](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/browse/CRDB-15001)

Jira issue: CRDB-18485
